question: Evaluate the determinant: $\begin{vmatrix} 1 & a & a^2 \\ 1 & b & b^2 \\ 1 & c & c^2 \end{vmatrix}$ for $a = 2$, $b = 3$, $c = 4$
explanation:
Substitute: $a = 2$, $b = 3$, $c = 4$

So the determinant becomes:
$\begin{vmatrix} 1 & 2 & 4 \\ 1 & 3 & 9 \\ 1 & 4 & 16 \end{vmatrix}$

Expand along R1:
$= 1 \begin{vmatrix} 3 & 9 \\ 4 & 16 \end{vmatrix} - 2\begin{vmatrix} 1 & 9 \\ 1 & 16 \end{vmatrix} + 4\begin{vmatrix} 1 & 3 \\ 1 & 4 \end{vmatrix}$
Calculate minors:
$\begin{vmatrix} 3 & 9 \\ 4 & 16 \end{vmatrix} = 3\times16 - 4\times9 = 48 - 36 = 12$
$\begin{vmatrix} 1 & 9 \\ 1 & 16 \end{vmatrix} = 1\times16 - 1\times9 = 16 - 9 = 7$
$\begin{vmatrix} 1 & 3 \\ 1 & 4 \end{vmatrix} = 1\times4 - 1\times3 = 4 - 3 = 1$
Plug back:
$= 1\times12 - 2\times7 + 4\times1 = 12 - 14 + 4 = 2$

$\boxed{2}$
